Reason: The chest X-ray (Figure 6) shows the classic "scimitar sign" on the right side, where an anomalous vein runs parallel to the right heart border, and there is associated mediastinal deviation to the right due to right lung hypoplasia. The CT images confirm the presence of an abnormal systemic artery supplying the inferior right lung (indicated by the arrow in Figure 1), which is a key feature of Scimitar syndrome.
